test_ToolRegistry_register_and_dispatch: test the ToolRegistry register method to add a tool with name, toolset, schema, and handler then dispatch it
test_ToolRegistry_get_definitions: test the ToolRegistry get_definitions method to return OpenAI-format function definitions for a set of tool names
test_ToolRegistry_check_toolset_requirem: test the ToolRegistry check_toolset_requirements method to verify availability of each registered toolset
test_discover_builtin_tools: test the discover_builtin_tools function to auto-discover and import self-registering tool modules from a directory
test_ToolRegistry_thread_safety: test the ToolRegistry thread safety by running concurrent register and check operations without errors
